entities.name: Carmelina Sánchez-Cutillas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carmelina Sánchez-Cutillas i Martínez del Romero was a Spanish historian, novelist and poet in Catalan language. Winner of the first Competition of Valencian Poetry of the University of Kentucky, a selection of her poem book Un món rebel (A rebel world) was translated into English in 1969.
